requirement:
Each documented annotation exposes its current tracked justification
under {cite}`requirements.test-coverage.index.file_map.notes.justifications`
and its last recorded review under
{cite}`requirements.test-coverage.index.file_map.notes.reviews`.
Missing justification and missing or unreadable stored reviews are
distinguished.
rationale: The reviewed tests adequately check `requirements.test-coverage.index.gaps.explanations`. **Obligations derived from the subject's text** 1. Each documented annotation shows its current tracked justification. 2. Each annotation shows its last recorded review. 3. A missing justification is distinguished from a present one. 4. A missing stored review is distinguished from an unreadable one. The cited requirements `requirements.test-coverage.index.file_map.notes.justifications` and `requirements.test-coverage.index.file_map.notes.reviews` supply context. I did not reassess their own tests. **Mapping to tests** - `src/execution_coverage/book.rs#mod[tests]/fn[overview_shows_missing_unreadable_and_recorded_reviews_with_current_justifications]` loops over every review state for one annotated function. - The states are missing, recorded true, recorded false, recorded FIXME, invalid JSON and an unreadable path (a directory in place of the file). - It asserts a distinct label for each: `Recorded review: Missing`, `Recorded true`, `Recorded false`, `Recorded FIXME` and `Unreadable`. - It asserts that the rationale `Saved overview rationale.` is shown for the readable determinations. - It asserts that the FIXME body `platform-only path` is shown. - It asserts the failure explanations `invalid JSON` and `cannot read evidence`. - It asserts that no stale or accepted wording appears. - This covers the "missing vs unreadable" distinction and the exposure of the recorded review. - The same test covers the "current" justification. It first shows the doc-comment justification `Original platform explanation.`. - It then edits the source. The updated text `Updated platform explanation.` replaces the original, and the original is asserted absent. - After a second edit that removes the doc comment, it asserts `No tracked justification is present.`. - The stored review stays shown (`Recorded true`) and is not modified, because the file bytes are compared before and after. - This covers the justification-present vs justification-missing distinction, and shows that the justification follows the current source rather than the stored review. - `src/execution_coverage/book.rs#mod[tests]/fn[documented_items_are_counted_once_with_browsable_directory_and_file_groups]` checks justifications for several annotation forms. - Fenced file-root commentary (`Root explanation.`) and two fenced function citations (`First explanation.`, `Second explanation.`). - A Rust doc comment (`Function explanation.`). - An unexplained function, which shows `No tracked justification is present.`. - It also asserts each file card's source location and that `Recorded review:` is present. - `src/execution_coverage/check.rs#mod[tests]/fn[book_browses_all_proposals_while_cli_checks_reviews_and_measurements]` checks the end-to-end rendering. - It checks the missing review label, the recorded true, false and FIXME labels, and the doc-comment justification. - After a source change it checks `No tracked justification is present.` together with the retained `Recorded true`. All three tests carry a `{test}` reference to the subject. I found no obligation that is untested or asserted wrongly.

text: :::{req} index.gaps.explanations
Each documented annotation exposes its current tracked justification
under {cite}`requirements.test-coverage.index.file_map.notes.justifications`
and its last recorded review under
{cite}`requirements.test-coverage.index.file_map.notes.reviews`.
Missing justification and missing or unreadable stored reviews are
distinguished.
:::{req} index.file_map.notes.justifications
The view of {cite}`requirements.test-coverage.index.file_map.notes` MUST show
each `habeas:coverage` citation attached to the file root or an explicitly
declared function or method. Each entry MUST identify its source item and
source location and show the fenced citation commentary and Rust doc comments
supplying its tracked justification under
{cite}`requirements.test-coverage.check.exceptions.anchor`.
When no tracked justification is present, the entry MUST say so.
File-root citations MUST be labelled as file-threshold exception proposals;
function and method citations MUST be labelled as function exception proposals,
following {cite}`requirements.test-coverage.check.exceptions.anchor`.
:::{req} index.file_map.notes.reviews
Each coverage annotation shows its last recorded citation-review
determination and rationale when readable. It distinguishes a missing review
from an unreadable review and explains failures to read the record.
Recorded results are labeled as recorded reviews; rendering does not check
whether they are current or authorize an execution-coverage exception.
